description: This file defines a PHP interface 'MailProcessor' within the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Core\Mail'. It specifies the method signatures for processing email templates and retrieving recipients in the OrangeHRM system, an HR management platform.

classes.name: MailProcessor
classes.description: An interface defining methods for email processing, including retrieving replacements for email templates and determining recipients based on roles and events.

methods.name: getReplacements
methods.description: Returns an array of replacement strings for a given email template, recipient, roles, and event.

methods.name: getRecipients
methods.description: Returns an array of AbstractRecipient objects representing the recipients for a given email, based on roles and event.
